title: Pro-AI Bias in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: The paper measures bias towards Artificial Intelligence across three methods: 1) behavioral assessment of how frequently and highly models recommend AI-related options in advice-seeking queries, 2) measuring the systematic overestimation of salaries for AI-related job titles relative to closely matched non-AI jobs, and 3) calculating the cosine similarity of internal representations to show that 'Artificial Intelligence' occupies a central, privileged position compared to other academic fields across positive, neutral, and negative prompts.
